### Covenant Curses
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/covenant-curses
Passage: Leviticus 26:14-16
Points:
- God established real, tangible consequences and curses for covenant unfaithfulness.
- The judgments in Leviticus 26 incrementally worsen as impenitence persists.
- The gradual intensification of discipline reveals God's patience and desire for sinners to repent.
- Continued defiance eventually results in the severe judgment of exile from God's blessings.
- God allows hardships in believers' lives to discipline them and draw them back to Himself.

### Devotional: Leviticus 26
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-26-psalm-33-eccl-9-titus-1/
Passage: Leviticus 26:14-39
Points:
- Leviticus 26 follows ancient suzerainty treaties outlining blessings for fidelity and penalties for rebellion.
- These covenant sanctions address the corporate welfare and obedience of the covenant people.
- Under the new covenant, genuine faith is still expected to produce a life of obedience.
- God deliberately ratchets up the severity of punishments over time, displaying immense forbearance.
- The only true remedy in the face of judgment is confession of sin and covenant renewal.
